findings.description: Session fetch failure falls back to null and shows Login as if signed out, conflating outage with unauthenticated state.
findings.risk: Authentication availability and security-state errors can be visually hidden.
findings.countermeasure: Separate loading, guest, authenticated, and session-error states; keep privileged links fail-closed; add failure-injection component test.

findings.description: Login UI prints provider brand/service state and sometimes raw server error code via showError; this is not demonstrated credential exposure.
findings.risk: Unnecessary implementation detail and misleading failure copy.
findings.countermeasure: Use generic user-safe CAPITAL-AI messages and mapped error codes with sanitized server-side diagnostics.

findings.description: Visual subscription tier comes from stored tier without requiring active/trialing status; authorization resolvePaidTier does require it.
findings.risk: Canceled/past-due plans can appear paid in the UI while entitlements deny paid service.
findings.countermeasure: Derive displayed current paid badge from same normalized status-aware tier projection and test canceled/past_due.

findings.description: ARIA menu/menuitem used without explicit Escape, focus-return, and arrow-navigation handlers observed in file; actual keyboard failure untested.
findings.risk: Keyboard/screenreader expectations for menu pattern may be unmet.
findings.countermeasure: Either implement complete menu keyboard pattern and focus management or use disclosure with ordinary buttons/links; verify in browser/AT.

findings.description: Notes and session are fetched once independently; no observed reset of client notes upon cookie/session identity change across tabs. No cross-user exploit was executed.
findings.risk: Stale first-account notes could be submitted after switching to another session in a separate tab.
findings.countermeasure: Bind notes state to a verified session identity, reset on identity mismatch, verify before save, add a two-account switching regression.

findings.description: Account profile/subscription projections select the first response row after id filter without independently validating returned id/user_id.
findings.risk: Upstream or fixture inconsistency could project wrong role/tier; actual cross-user behavior not observed.
findings.countermeasure: Require matching profile.id and subscription.user_id to verified subject and fail closed on mismatch.

findings.description: Notes RPC receives server-verified userId; SQL grants only service-role access; existing unit tests describe client-selected userId rejection.
findings.risk: Protection established by source inspection, not live tenant/DB RLS runtime test.
findings.countermeasure: Maintain negative tests and prove against a real test database with separate users.

findings.description: Full web tree shows no independent Android/iOS app code or native workflow; skill still points to removed mobile/android-private and workflow paths.
findings.risk: Obsolete instructions can misroute future audits into nonexistent source paths.
findings.countermeasure: Update repository anchors to separate mobile repository boundary without modifying that repository.
